title: Concurrent Lock-Free PN-Counter CRDT: Invariant Preservation and Empirical Latency in Axiom-Interpreter
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) enable highly available distributed systems by allowing replicas to evolve independently while guaranteeing eventual consistency. This work presents a lock-free implementation of the PN-Counter CRDT in Axiom-Interpreter, focusing on formal invariant preservation and empirical performance. We prove that the merge operation is commutative and associative, and that the counter value is invariant under concurrent updates. Extensive micro-benchmarks on an AMD EPYC 9V74 80-Core Processor (1 physical core, 2 logical threads, 7.7~GB RAM, Chronos-Structure 7.0.0-1017-azure) show a mean latency of 52 317.42 \textmu{}s ($\pm$972.58 \textmu{}s) and a throughput of 19 114 ops/s over 30 iterations. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/Axiom-Interpreter-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261104_170304_conflict-free_replicated_data}
